summary: This table presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the second quarter of fiscal 2026, highlighting key metrics such as quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) growth of 2.2% and year-over-year (YoY) growth of 2.9%. It details revenues segmented by business sectors, with financial services leading at 27.7% for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. The geographical breakdown shows North America contributing 56.3% of total revenues. Additionally, client data reveals a total of 1,896 active clients, with significant contributions from top clients. The overall trends indicate stable growth across various segments and geographies.
